title: [Shopify] Improve shop navigation and background sync guidance
summary: The Shopify integration adds shop-filtered payment actions to the Shop Card's Related menu and improves background synchronization guidance by directing users to Job Queue entries with clearer job descriptions.
key_points: Payment Transactions and Payouts actions added to Shop Card Related menu
Shop-filtered navigation for both payment actions
Users directed to Job Queue Log Entries for background sync status
Job descriptions clarified to distinguish product, price, and inventory synchronization
quote: Add shop-filtered Payment Transactions and Payouts actions at the end of the Shopify Shop Card's Related menu.
